youtube_title: KYC Pending, Account Blocked Tonight? That SMS Is a Scam. Scam of the Week #8 #Shorts
youtube_description:
SCAM OF THE WEEK #8. An SMS says your KYC is pending and your account will be blocked tonight - click the link. A: open the link and update. B: ignore the link and ask your bank yourself.
Answer: B. RBI has warned about frauds in the name of KYC updation: fake SMS, calls and emails with links, false urgency and threats to block your account. They get you to install an app and then take your login, OTP and PIN. For any KYC request, contact your bank directly using the number on its official website, never share OTP/PIN, and if you're scammed call 1930 or report at cybercrime.gov.in.
Source: RBI press release, 2 Feb 2024.

SMS aaya: 'Dear customer, aapka KYC pending hai, aaj raat account BLOCK ho jaayega. Link pe click karo.' 😨
A: link khol ke KYC update. B: link chhodo, khud bank se pucho.
Sahi hai B ✅ RBI ki warning: KYC ke naam pe fake SMS/calls, account block ki dhamki ke saath. Link se app install, phir login, OTP, PIN sab unke paas. Account khaali.
KYC message aaye toh seedha bank se confirm karo, number sirf official website se. Fraud hua? Turant 1930.
